The defect review failed. Fix what blocks it, then ask for a new review:
F8: On /ratametsuri/ and /en/ratametsuri/, the introductory status says the app is in development but shows no status checked date, in either theme or text size. M1 explicitly requires the checked date next to the status wherever the work item appears; D24 adds this page without exempting it. The linked products-list row already has checked: 2026-11-12. Render the verified checked date beside the landing-page status in each locale, ideally from the same work metadata, or obtain an explicit owner-approved model exception. This is missing status metadata, not a Finnish editorial or consent wording change.
